```yaml
name: OpenSSF Scorecard

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  scorecard:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Verify SPDX license in package.json
        run: |
          echo "Checking license field in package.json files..."
          find . -name package.json -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            license=$(jq -r '.license' "$file")
            if [ "$license" != "MIT" ]; then
              echo "❌ $file has license $license"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ All package.json files have license MIT"

      - name: Run OpenSSF Scorecard
        uses: ossf/scorecard-action@v1
        with:
          repo: ${{ github.repository }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          output: scorecard.json
          badge: true
          badge-file: scorecard.svg

      - name: Commit scorecard badge
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          # Add badge file
          if [ -f scorecard.svg ]; then
            git add scorecard.svg
          fi

          # Insert badge into README if not present
          if ! grep -q "OpenSSF Scorecard" README.md; then
            sed -i '1i![OpenSSF Scorecard](scorecard.svg)\n' README.md
            git add README.md
          fi

          # Commit only if there are changes
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore: update OpenSSF Scorecard badge"
            git push
          else
            echo "No changes to commit."
          fi
```
